title: Kalaam: Janab Hassan Abbas Ahsan Sahab.
body:
Hogaye Shabbir (asws) Tanha Margaya Beta Jawaa'n.
1. Zalzala Aaya Zamee'n Ko Kaanp Utha Aasma'n *2.
Jalti Reti Par Jon'hi.. Akbar Ne Ragdi Ediyaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Jisko Athara(18) Baras Paala Tha Armaano'n Ke Saath..*2.
Haaye Us Kadiyal Jawaa'n Ke.... Seene Mein Tooti Sinaa.
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Tere Baba Ne Tadapte Dekha Hain Akbar (asws) Tujhe..*2.
Kaise Bhoolega Dam E .... Aaqir Wo Teri Hichkiyaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Tere Gham Mein Badh Gayi Yun Tishnagi Shabbir (asws) Ki..*2.
Ek Dhuaa'n Sa Chaa Gaya.... Arzo Samaa Ke Darmiyaa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dekha Hai Jalti Zamee'n Par Laasha Tera Bekafan..*2.
Ab Na Saaye Mein Kabhi..... Baithegi Akber (asws) Teri Maa'n.
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Jiska Baba Saaqi E Kousar (asws) Ka Ahsan Laal Hain..*2.
Pyaas Ki Shiddat Mein Nikli..... Us Jawaa'n Bete Ki Jaa'n.
Margaya Beta Jawaa'n.
Kalaam: Janab Hassan Abbas Ahsan Sahab.
